inputs.input_cost: separately timed and excluded from tick_ns
inputs.tick_metric: steady_clock wall-clock nanoseconds around World::tick only
inputs.startup: reported separately; excluded from warmup and sample tick metrics

contrasts.claim: padded64 physical layout cost relative to word64
packed72 cost relative to matched word64
packed80 cost relative to matched word64

aligned80 cost relative to matched word64
split72 cost relative to matched word64
split80 cost relative to matched word64

run_order.within_contrast: seven independent pairs; pair i uses pair_orders[i], each letter is a fresh process

binary_contract.source: one immutable S1 baseline/native snapshot and hash-guarded per-arm overlay
binary_contract.observers: MAT003_TWIN_OBSERVERS=0; candidate correctness atomics compiled out
binary_contract.apparatus: one timing-capable binary per arm with qualify and measure modes; same sealed binary must pass untimed qualify mode before later measure mode
binary_contract.qualification_mode: does not call timing clocks and must emit empty tick_ns/input_ns
binary_contract.measurement_mode: same sealed binary records startup separately, input_ns outside tick interval, tick_ns around World::tick only
binary_contract.semantic_capture: no per-tick semantic snapshot/trace in measurement mode; final hashes/work/ledgers retained outside timed interval

apparatus_qualification.required_contexts: each arm in every anchor where that arm appears in a contrast
requirements: all builds sealed before qualifier execution
qualify mode emits no timing arrays
source/candidate semantics and work match registered source reference per anchor
closed Water input source/sink ledger reconciles
performance binary contains dormant measure mode but qualification invokes only qualify
independent verifier checks exact build/context set and binary hashes

stop_rules: source/native drift, toolchain mismatch or binary hash mismatch refuses execution
nonzero exit, timeout, stderr diagnostic or malformed evidence rejects the process
semantic/work/input-ledger mismatch rejects the arm/context before any timing
timing process count/order must be exactly 224; budget stop is incomplete
no replacement, retry or omission may be silently substituted for a registered process

reporting.primary: seven process-level B/A ratios per contrast plus median and spread; retain all raw per-tick samples
reporting.clear_interpretation: E8 sample includes its registered natural clear when it falls in the 120+256 horizon; E16 does not naturally clear in this horizon. Do not infer E16 long-run maintenance from S2A; separately measured wide-epoch clear latency remains required before final epoch-width selection.
reporting.zero_visit: report absolute tick latency; never divide by zero visits

deferred: all timing until apparatus qualification and separate admission amendment
wide-epoch clear-latency calibration and amortized long-run epoch-cost conclusion
